context.title: Projects
context.description: Your projects: folders of MedBiquitous documents (Healthcare LOM and the other standards), validated in the background. Create and open projects, add, convert, rename and delete documents with the tool bar and the context menu; F2 renames, Delete deletes, F5 refreshes.

context.title: Validation
context.description: The problems of the active document from the XML Schema, model and rule checks of its standard. In Healthcare LOM records, a light bulb marks problems with a quick fix (Ctrl+1) and Fix All repairs every automatic problem in one undoable step; double-click shows the element.

context.title: Library
context.description: All MedBiquitous documents below a folder with their validation status and, for Healthcare LOM records, their kind, credits, audience and completeness (for other documents the Kind column shows the standard). Search, filter by kind and status, sort by any column, and export catalog cards and library reports.

context.title: Compare
context.description: A field-by-field comparison of two documents of the same standard. Healthcare LOM records are grouped by category and repeated elements are matched by meaning, so reordering is not reported as a change; documents of the other standards are compared by element path, grouped by the parts of the root element. Double-click a field to show it in the editor.

context.title: HLOM Guide
context.description: The in-application guide to Healthcare LOM: elements, healthcare extensions, vocabularies, conformance, credit acronyms, professions and specialties. Shift+F1 in a field opens its topic here.

context.title: Start Page
context.description: Shown while no document is open: create a document or project, open a file or a sample, start from a template, or reopen a recent document.

context.title: Hermes Document Search
context.description: Searches the field values of the documents of your projects for text or a regular expression, optionally case sensitive or whole words, and limited to field groups such as titles, keywords or credits. Attribute values such as MeSH IDs are searched too; unsaved documents are searched as edited.

context.title: MedBiquitous Editor
context.description: Edits one MedBiquitous document on the form pages of its standard, as a tree and as XML (Healthcare LOM records also as JSON); all pages share one undo history. Use the navigation sidebar to switch pages; badges count the problems of each page.

context.title: Document Tree
context.description: All elements of the document, including custom extensions. Select an element to edit its attributes in the Properties view; add elements with New Child and New Sibling.

context.title: XML
context.description: The XML source of the document, with content assist (Ctrl+Space) from the schemas of its standard, live schema checking, quick fixes (Ctrl+1, Healthcare LOM), formatting (Ctrl+Shift+F) and comment toggling (Ctrl+/). Text changes are applied when you leave the page or save.

context.title: JSON
context.description: The document in the JSON form of the MedBiquitous Healthcare LOM JSON Schema, with content assist (Ctrl+Space), live syntax checking and formatting (Ctrl+Shift+F). Text changes are applied when you leave the page or save.

context.title: Overview
context.description: Summary and validation status of the document. For a Healthcare LOM record also key facts, completeness and next steps that link to the pages where the most valuable information is missing; for the other standards the standard and version and the contents of the document.

context.title: General (1)
context.description: Identification, title, description, keywords, coverage, languages, structure and aggregation level of the learning object. Use Look Up to add keywords coded with MeSH or ICD-10-CM.

context.title: Life Cycle (2)
context.description: Version and status of the learning object and its contributors (authors, publishers, reviewers) with their roles, vCards and dates.

topic.label: Life Cycle in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Meta-Metadata (3)
context.description: The metadata record itself: its identifiers, contributors, language and metadata schemas. Healthcare LOM records must declare LOMv1.0 and HEALTHCARE_LOMv1.

context.title: Technical (4)
context.description: Formats (MIME types), size, locations, duration, requirements and installation remarks of the learning object.

context.title: Educational (5)
context.description: Educational characteristics, one entry per intended use: interactivity, learning resource types, intended end user roles, contexts, difficulty and typical learning time.

context.title: Rights (6)
context.description: Cost, copyright and other restrictions, and a description of the conditions of use.

context.title: Relation (7)
context.description: Other resources related to this learning object, the kind of relationship and the identifiers of the target resource.

context.title: Annotation (8)
context.description: Comments on the educational use of the learning object, each with its author (vCard), date and description.

context.title: Classification (9)
context.description: Classifications by purpose, for example competencies or learning outcomes, with taxon paths that can be filled from MeSH, ICD-10-CM, ACGME, Bloom's taxonomy or the AAMC Curriculum Inventory.

context.title: Healthcare Education
context.description: The MedBiquitous extension for educational offerings: credits (one entry per credit type), target audience, disclosures, schedule and activity location.

topic.label: Credit acronyms in the HLOM Guide

context.title: Healthcare Asset
context.description: The MedBiquitous extension for medical images and other assets: clinical history, specimen type, medical image type, annotation, orientation, magnification and dimensions.

context.title: New MedBiquitous Document
context.description: Creates a document of any MedBiquitous standard. Choose the standard; Healthcare LOM records start from a template (blank record, CME course, medical image asset, patient education resource or live workshop), the other standards from their standard's template. Enter the title and language, choose XML or (Healthcare LOM only) JSON and the file.

context.title: Project
context.description: The name, location, description and format of new documents of a project. They are stored in the project folder's hermes-project.json.

context.title: Import from CSV
context.description: Creates one Healthcare LOM record per row of a CSV file: choose the file and template, map the columns to HLOM fields, review the validated records and choose where to save them.

context.title: Terminology Lookup
context.description: Searches the offline terminologies by name, synonym or code, or browses their hierarchy, and shows definitions, synonyms and related concepts. The chosen concepts become coded keywords or a taxon path.

context.title: Contributor vCard
context.description: Composes a vCard 3.0 entry for a contributing person or organization from the full name, organization and email.

context.title: Translations
context.description: The same text in several languages: one row per language. Add and remove languages and click a cell to edit it.

context.title: Fix All
context.description: Lists the automatic fixes with the problems they repair. Deselect fixes you don't want; the selected fixes are applied as one change that Edit > Undo reverts.

context.title: Healthcare LOM Preferences
context.description: The default language and format of new documents, your identity as author (written as a vCard) and the library folder.

context.title: Validation Preferences
context.description: Whether the active document is validated after each change, the delay before validating, and whether informational hints are shown.

context.title: MeSH Preferences
context.description: MeSH lookups use the offline index. Optionally, descriptor IDs it doesn't know are looked up with the NLM MeSH service.

context.title: Terminologies Preferences
context.description: The terminologies included in Hermes 2 with their versions, sources and license notices.
